heroSubtitle: Sebenzisa i-Claude, i-GPT ne-Gemini kusuka kuhlelo lokusebenza olulodwa lwedeskithophu newebhu, ngokufinyelela ngqo kumafayela akho, ikhodi ne-Gmail. Faka imali esikhwameni kusuka ku-$1 bese ukhokhela isicelo ngasinye.
heroCreditsNotice: {credits} amakhredithi amahhala uma ubhalisa. Faka imali nge-USD noma i-NGN uma udinga okwengeziwe.
featureModelsBody: Khetha i-Claude, i-GPT, i-Gemini noma i-DeepSeek ebhokisini lomlayezo. Impendulo ngayinye ikhombisa ukuthi kubize malini.
featureDesktopTitle: Isebenza emshinini wakho. Icela imvume ngaphambi kokwenza.
featureDesktopBody: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu lufunda amafayela akho futhi lusebenzise imiyalo kumaphrojekthi akho. Noma yini eshintsha okuthile ilinda imvume yakho.
featureToolsTitle: Ifunda ama-PDF akho, iseshe iwebhu, ihlole ibhokisi lakho lemeyili.
featureToolsBody: Hlaziya imibiko, sesha iwebhu, bese ubuza ibhokisi lakho lemeyili. Izenzo ezibucayi zihlala zilinda imvume yakho.
featurePricingBody: Ayikho uhlelo lwanyanga zonke. Faka imali uma uthanda bese usebenzisa amakhredithi umyalezo owodwa ngesikhathi.
finalCtaSubtitle: Landa uhlelo lokusebenza noma ulivule kusiphequluli sakho. Akukho okubhaliselwe okumele ukukhanselwe.
step1Body: Landa uhlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu noma ngena ngemvume kuwebhu. Uqala ngamakhredithi amahhala angu-{credits}.
step2Body: Khetha i-Claude, i-GPT, i-Gemini noma enye imodeli, bese ushintsha umqondo wakho kumyalezo olandelayo.
step3Body: Xoxa, noma uyikhombise amafayela akho, ama-PDF nebhokisi lemeyili. Ukhokhela kuphela izicelo ozithumelayo.
useCaseExcel: Buyekeza amashidi e-Excel ngaphandle kokwazi i-Excel
useCaseMeeting: Guqula amanothi omhlangano angcolile abe yizenzo ezicacile
useCaseCode: Bhala futhi ulungise ikhodi ngaphandle kobuhlungu bekhanda
faqBillingA: Ufaka imali esikhwameni kusuka ku-$1 nge-USD noma i-NGN. Isicelo ngasinye sidonsa izindleko zaso, ngokusekelwe kumodeli oyikhethile. Ayikho uhlelo lwanyanga zonke.
faqModelsA: I-Claude, i-GPT, i-Gemini, i-DeepSeek, i-Llama nokuningi, okudluliswa nge-OpenRouter. Ungashintsha amamodeli kunoma yimuphi umyalezo.
faqDesktopQ: Yini uhlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu olungafinyelela kuyo?
faqDesktopA: Amafayela akho endawo namaphrojekthi, kanye nemiyalo oyivunyelwe. Izenzo ezishintsha okuthile zilinda imvume yakho kuqala.
faqWebQ: Ngingakwazi ukukusebenzisa ngaphandle kokufaka noma yini?
faqWebA: Yebo. Ngena ngemvume kuwebhu. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu lungeza ukufinyelela kumafayela akho endawo namaphrojekthi.
faqFreeA: {credits} amakhredithi amahhala ukuze uzame, ngaphandle kokubhaliselwe okumele ukukhanselwe.
footerTagline: Indawo yokusebenza eyodwa yayo yonke imodeli yomngcele. Khokhela lokho okusebenzisayo.
smartScreenDesc: I-Microsoft Defender SmartScreen ivimbele uhlelo lokusebenza olungaziwa ukuthi luqale. Ukusebenzisa lolu hlelo lokusebenza kungabeka i-PC yakho engozini.
windowsIntro: I-AIGenius isisha, ngakho-ke i-Windows SmartScreen ingase ikuxwayise. Nansi indlela yokuyivula:
freeCreditsNotice: P.S. Uthola amakhredithi amahhala angu-{credits} uma ubhalisa kuhlelo lokusebenza.
demoNoticeWorkspaces: Ukushintsha izindawo zokusebenza kuyingxenye yohlelo lokusebenza olugcwele.
demoNoticeLive: Lokhu ukubuka kuqala okubukhoma, ngakho-ke iwindi lihlala endaweni.
demoNoticeAttach: Ukufaka amafayela kusebenza kuhlelo lokusebenza olugcwele.

demoLinuxModalTitle: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu lwe-Linux luyeza maduze
